clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath Teldrassil's boughs, Fel Cones carry corruption into the forest. Night elf defenders put the pods to use against nearby tricksters.

Beneath Teldrassil's boughs, Fel Cones show that corruption has reached the young tree. Gnarled and fallen, the pine cones billow foul green smoke. They lie scattered just east of Dolanaar. Tainted magic has warped the surrounding flora, and the pods are dangerous to touch or eat without caution.
